The number of calories found in food varies based on food type. Table 1.1 lists the number of calories found in 
macronutrients. Food preparation can modify the number of calories present. For example, a raw tomato has fewer 
calories than a fried tomato. Water is classified as a macronutrient. Although it serves a vital role, it does not provide 
energy to the body.

Counting calories is one way to determine if clients are consuming an appropriate amount of food to meet their 
needs. Calorie needs vary based upon client age, sex, and level of physical activity. Use this calorie calculator 
(https://openstax.org/r/calculnet) when working with clients to determine their individual caloric needs.
